newsitem.title: UK: UK shares finish higher as U.S. rally continues.
newsitem.headline: UK shares finish higher as U.S. rally continues.

text.p: British shares closed higher on Thursday, inspired by Wall Street's continuing advance, the return of domestic bid speculation and positive results from one of Britain's top companies.

The FTSE 100 index finished up 22.8 points at 4,327.1 but off the day's best levels after faltering on the brink of an intraday record. The FTSE had mounted an assault on the previous high of 4,330, set on Monday, but stopped just 0.1 points short.
Dealers said sentiment was underpinned by encouraging annual results from Shell Transport and Trading Co Plcand news of a possible bid approach for Chubb Security.
